name: aircraft_wing
description: Tapered NACA-0015 cantilever aircraft wing (aluminium 6061, 200 mm span, 80->48 mm chord) — airfoil loft + volume-fraction gates plus a two-case aerodynamic lift/neg-g FEM check.

stages.prompt:
Tapered cantilever aircraft wing, parametric — symmetric NACA 0015 airfoil.

Frame: span along X, chord along Y, thickness along Z; bottom of the root section rests on the XY plane (z = 0); centred in X and Y. mm.
- Span 200 along X from the root at x = -100 to the tip at x = +100 (centred in X).
- Linearly tapered planform centred on y = 0 (the mid-chord line is the X axis):
  * Root chord at x = -100: 80 (y = -40..+40; leading edge y = -40, trailing edge y = +40).
  * Tip chord at x = +100: 48 (y = -24..+24; leading edge y = -24, trailing edge y = +24).
- Symmetric NACA 0015 airfoil (t = 0.15) with the chord plane at z = 6.0:
  * Half-thickness: z_t(s) = 5 * 0.15 * c * (0.2969*sqrt(s) - 0.1260*s - 0.3516*s^2 + 0.2843*s^3 - 0.1036*s^4), s in [0,1] from leading edge (y = -c/2) to closed trailing edge (y = +c/2); upper surface z = 6.0 + z_t, lower surface z = 6.0 - z_t.
  * Root (c = 80): max thickness 12.0 -> z = 0..12 (touches the XY plane at z = 0). Tip (c = 48): max thickness 7.2 -> z = 2.4..9.6.
  * Loft across >= 4 spanwise sections (x = -100, -33.3, +33.3, +100) with >= 40 points per surface (smooth loft, solid interior), flat planar root and tip end caps at x = -100 and x = +100.
- Overall bounding box exactly 200 (X) x 80 (Y) x 12 (Z). No holes, cutouts, fillets or chamfers.
